text:
Maya Patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing the same two patterns: (1) regional cloud auth spikes that cause model-registry token churn, and (2) model-registry write latencies that cascade into client timeouts. Need a tight action list + owners.
Alex Chen: Agree. I'd like to avoid ad-hoc fixes. Propose a 3-track plan: short-term runbook fixes, mid-term SLA/alerting changes, long-term infra changes (replication + fallback).
Samir Gupta: +1. For short-term: add a circuit-breaker on registry writes and a cached token fallback for 30s. I can own the registry code change. ETA: EOW?
Dena Ortiz: That sounds right. I'll take alerting: add a P95 write-latency alert and a cross-service auth-failure rate alert. Will add runbook steps to escalate to cloud-provider on-call. ETA: Tue EOD.
Maya Patel: Samir (registry code) + Dena (alerts) — please post PR links and runbook diffs here when ready. Also need a vendor engagement owner to push for root-cause from cloud team.
samir gupta: Working on a branch now, pushing minimal circuit-breaker. Patch will include metrics: registry.write.circuit_open_count and fallback_hit_count.
Alex Chen: I'll take vendor engagement this cycle. I'll prepare a vendor timeline and escalate if we see retries > 5% for 15m.
Dena Ortiz: Adding the runbook snippet now:
```
- If registry.write.P95 > 1s for 5m -> page SRE
- Check cloud-region health dashboard -> if degraded, switch traffic to secondary region (manual for now)
- If auth failure rate > 2% for 15m -> enable token-cache fallback, open vendor ticket
- Owner: oncall -> then ops lead
```
Maya Patel: Nice. Also request: add a daily synthetic that posts a small test model to registry and validates auth token exchange. If it fails, auto-create an incident. Who can add the synthetic?
Samir Gupta: I can wire the synthetic into our existing smoke harness, should be a 2h task. Will include a quick-runbook check.
Dena Ortiz: I'll wire the alert to the synthetic failure too.
sre-bot: Automated note: Created checklist ticket INC-2748 with subtasks for registry circuit-breaker, alerts, synthetic smoke, and vendor outreach. Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-2748
Maya Patel: Ownership matrix for visibility:
- Registry circuit-breaker: Samir (owner)
- Alerts & runbook: Dena (owner)
- Vendor engagement: Alex (owner)
- Synthetic smoke: Samir (owner)
- Incident checklist & tracking: Ops (sre-bot)
Maya Patel: Timeline proposals: short-term fixes by EOW, alerts by Tue, synthetic by Wed, vendor update meeting scheduled Friday 10:00 PT. Anyone see a blocker?
Alex Chen: No blockers from my side. I'll draft the vendor agenda and include the logs we captured.
Samir Gupta: EOW seems tight but doable; if I'm blocked I'll ping for help.
Dena Ortiz: I'll sync with oncall to ensure someone is ready to run manual region failover (we should document the steps).
Maya Patel: I'll follow up Friday after the vendor meeting with an update. Please add any PR links or runbook diffs here. :eyes: 
Alex Chen: Added calendar invite for Friday 10:00 PT. :calendar:
Samir Gupta: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1227 — includes circuit-breaker + metrics. Marking as WIP.
Dena Ortiz: Runbook diff posted: https://docs.internal/runbooks/registry-failover.md#diff
Maya Patel: Great progress. We'll re-check recurrence patterns after these changes and decide on long-term options (regional replication, active-active registry). For now, sync on Friday. :thumbsup:
